name: lossless-compaction
description: Lossless context compaction for Claude Code: old tool output moves to local files and comes back unchanged by id, or by what it is about with a Jev key.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where Jev is asked when the find tool is called: auto, typesafe or cloudflare. auto asks Cloudflare when an account id is entered here and TypeSafe when none is. A key in the environment is used only once this is set to typesafe or cloudflare, or an account id is entered: on auto with none, only the key set here is. Leave the key unset to have no find tool and send nothing; recall works without one.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The key for Jev, used by the find tool only. With provider left on auto, it is sent to Cloudflare when an account id is entered here and to TypeSafe when none is. Unset, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is read from the environment once provider is set to typesafe, and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN once Cloudflare is chosen, unless a repository's settings put it there; left on auto with no account id, a key in the environment is not used. Set it in your user settings.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account id
cloudflareAccountId.description: 32 hexadecimal characters, for Jev on Cloudflare Workers AI. With provider left on auto, entering one sends the key to Cloudflare; leave it empty for TypeSafe. Unset, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is read only when provider is cloudflare and the key comes from the environment too.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model name for the typesafe provider.

storeDir.title: Where moved-out results are kept
storeDir.description: An absolute directory, set in your user settings: one from a repository's settings stops the plugin. It is made, or closed, to mode 700 before anything is written, so give it a directory of its own. Unset, lossless-compaction under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when that is set, else under ~/.claude; an existing jev-lossless-compaction directory there, from earlier versions, is written to instead, and both are read.

targetPercent.title: Target size
targetPercent.description: Results are moved out until the context is estimated to be under this share, in percent, of the size at which Claude Code compacts on its own (the model's window when auto-compaction is off); only where it is not reached do long inputs, the middles of long messages and old calls leave after them. At 1, the default, it is not reached in a window of 200,000: everything that may leave does, at every compaction, but the newest keepTokens of results, of long inputs and of long messages, and the calls among the newest keepTokens of the conversation. Set it higher to leave more in place. Where the oldest messages are kept in place of a summary, they are cut down to the same size. From 1 to 99; a number outside is taken as the nearest end, and the session says so.

keepTokens.title: Newest results to leave alone, in tokens
keepTokens.description: The newest tool result that could leave always stays; the ones before it stay while they and the newest add up to this many tokens (three characters to a token). 0 keeps the newest one only. Long inputs have an allowance of this size of their own, and so do long messages. A /compact typed without instructions reaches into them too where that is not enough, up to the last thing you said. Where the oldest messages are kept in place of a summary, the newest messages stay while they add up to this many tokens, unless fewer have to stay for the conversation to fit. From 0 to 1,000,000; a number outside is taken as the nearest end, and the session says so.

minChars.title: Smallest result to move out
minChars.description: Tool results, input values and messages shorter than this many characters are not moved out one by one. Old short calls may still fold into a list with what they returned. From 0 to 10,000,000; a number outside is taken as the nearest end, and the session says so.

maxAfterPercent.title: Largest size to go on with
maxAfterPercent.description: When the context is still over this share, in percent, of the size at which Claude Code compacts on its own (the model's window when auto-compaction is off), the oldest messages are kept in parts and a list of them stands in their place, with no summary. A `/compact` given instructions runs the built-in compaction on what is left, whatever is in use. From 1 to 100; a number outside is taken as the nearest end, and the session says so.
